_note: Constants the Puzzle Pirates wiki does not publish are invented here and nowhere else, so invented numbers stay visibly separate from sourced ones and tuning stays a data change. Every key carries an entry in _sources saying where its value came from; a key with no entry is a bug.

_sources.bilging.boardWidth: invented; the wiki never states the grid dimensions
_sources.bilging.boardHeight: invented; the wiki only requires at least 3 water rows and at least 3 dry top rows, so the height must be at least 6
_sources.bilging.colourCountByStarLevel: invented, anchored on the published 7 colours at star level 7
_sources.bilging.maxStarLevel: the star level the wiki anchors on: 7 colours, and every critter unlocked, the jellyfish last at 6
_sources.bilging.startingStarLevel: scope decision; an offline pirate starts with no standing to draw a difficulty from
_sources.bilging.ticksPerStarStep: invented; one star level per minute of play at 60 ticks per second
_sources.bilging.comboMultiplierByLineCount: published for 1, 2 and 3 lines; index 4 is the low end of the published range at least 4, maybe 5; index 5 is invented
_sources.bilging.comboScalePerMilleByStarLevel: invented; the wiki publishes the combo table at 7-star level and only says the multipliers are lower below it, so index 7 is 1000 to keep the published table exact
_sources.bilging.vegasMultiplier: the low end of the published range at least 5, maybe 6-7
_sources.bilging.chainPointsPerCell: published; a chain is worth no more than 1 point per block cleared
_sources.bilging.pufferSpawnPerMille: invented; the wiki never states how often a critter appears, and the puffer is the commonest of the three
_sources.bilging.crabSpawnPerMille: invented; rarer than the puffer because a crab denies its square until it climbs out
_sources.bilging.jellySpawnPerMille: invented; the rarest of the three, since one jelly clears a whole colour
_sources.bilging.crabPointsAtFullWater: invented against the published anchor that two crabs cleared at full water score between a bingo of 27 and a sea donkey of 48; 9 puts two crabs at 36
_sources.bilging.pufferPointsPerCell: published in effect; the wiki calls the puffer score-negative, so the detonation itself pays nothing and only the chain it triggers scores
_sources.bilging.jellyPointsPerCell: invented; a jelly sweep is worth no more per cell than a chain
_sources.bilging.aboveWaterFallTicksPerCell: invented; the wiki says only that pieces fall more slowly below the water line, never how much
_sources.bilging.belowWaterFallTicksPerCell: invented; twice the dry rate, the smallest ratio that reads as slower
_sources.bilging.inflowPerMillePerThousandTicks: invented; the bilge-to-performance coupling rate is nowhere on the wiki. An ignored board floods from empty to full in about 119 seconds
_sources.bilging.pumpPerMillePerThousandTicks: invented; the board drains at any efficiency above 467 per mille and empties from full in about 104 seconds at 100 per cent efficiency
_sources.bilging.ratingBandsPerMille: invented; the lower bound of poor, fine, good, excellent and incredible, honouring the published fine at about 100 per cent and sparkly at 4 points per move
